items.text: Seahawks rookie RB Jadarian Price questionable to return due to chest injury.
49ers WR Mike Evans has hip injury, questionable to return; Shanahan says doesn’t look serious (Demarcus Robinson high ankle).
items.why: In-game; ETR not expected serious; Rapoport corroborates.
items.implication: Monitor; likely returns or limited impact.
items.opportunity: If out longer, other 49ers WRs/TE up.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels ruled out with dislocated left elbow (X-rays negative, no fracture); expected to miss time (prior similar injury ~4 games/month); additional testing Monday.
items.why: Carted off; HC Quinn confirmed dislocation; Rapoport expected miss time.
items.implication: Sit rest of season short-term; roster backup QB.

items.text: Bears QB Caleb Williams suffered hamstring injury; walking under own power no crutches, slight limp possible; tests Monday.
items.why: In-game; Rapoport notes walking good spirits better than alternatives; ETR watching.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is officially active for Week 2.
items.why: Official confirmation after Rapoport optimism and limited Friday practice; would wear flak jacket.
items.implication: Playable WR2 but monitor for limited effectiveness/docks.
items.opportunity: Full route tree potential if no setback; primary target.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey (hamstring) is inactive for Week 2.
items.why: Official inactive after ETR not expected and hamstring issue.
items.implication: Sit; look to backups for upside.

items.text: Packers WR Jayden Reed (neck/head) ruled out; has feeling/movement all extremities, overnight testing/observation.
items.why: Ruled out; Schefter update on feeling/movement.

items.text: Eagles RB Saquon Barkley (stinger) is questionable to return.
Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) is inactive/OUT for Week 2; expected back Week 3.
items.why: Official inactive after doubtful tag and limited practice; Rapoport optimistic for W3.
items.opportunity: Full TE targets to Michael Mayer.

items.text: Ladd McConkey officially ACTIVE; RJ Harvey inactive—grab Jonah Coleman now if ignored preseason. Agrees Bernard stash (YAC/McCarthy fit) with Pittman out.
items.why: Active confirm + inactive opens backup; Bernard YAC fit.
items.implication: Lock McConkey in; stash depth pieces.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is active; expected to play.
items.why: Schefter expected to play; Levitan no real docks.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back), listed questionable, is officially active vs Texans.
items.why: Confirmed active; Rapoport earlier said will play.
items.implication: Start as QB1 even in tough matchup.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected; no docks noted.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua (hip) is a true game-time decision for MNF; Schefter notes pre-game decision, some trending wrong direction reports.
items.why: ETR/Levitan true GTD; limited/no practice; Schefter pre-game.
items.implication: Have backup ready; start if active but risk.
items.opportunity: If out, boosts other Rams WRs.

items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, official status likely late; flak jacket if plays.
items.why: Bullish reports + practice improvement; docks for rib.
items.implication: Start with tempered expectations vs full health.
items.opportunity: Still high target share if active.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers (hamstring) is OUT.
items.why: ETR summary and inactives confirm; Rapoport notes opens door for others.
items.implication: Sit; pivot to other Ravens pass-catchers.

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot) is OUT.
Texans WR Nico Collins (hamstring) is OUT for Week 2.
items.why: Confirmed on injury reports and inactives.

items.text: Olave sounds fine no docks; expecting decent look at backups with Harvey doubtful and Pittman out.
items.why: Clean reports on Olave; role expansion for depth with absences.
items.implication: Olave full go; handcuff/backup RBs/WRs relevant.
